# ¿Estoy expuesto? / Am I Exposed?

> Free tool that checks whether an email address or a password appears in known
> data breaches, and then explains in plain language what to change first.
> Available in Spanish and English. No account is needed to run a check, email
> addresses are not stored, and passwords are checked with k-anonymity: only the
> first five characters of a SHA-1 hash ever leave the browser, so the password
> itself is never sent anywhere. A paid report adds a personalised action plan.

> Herramienta gratuita para revisar si un correo o una contraseña aparece en una
> filtración de datos conocida, con una explicación clara de qué hacer después.
> No pide cuenta, no guarda el correo, y la contraseña nunca sale del navegador.

## The tool

- [¿Estoy expuesto? / Am I Exposed?](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/): the checker
  itself, served in Spanish by default and in English through the language
  switch.

## Written pages (Spanish)

- [Preguntas frecuentes](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/preguntas-frecuentes/):
  what happens to your email, how a password is checked without being seen, and
  what appearing in a breach does and does not mean.
- [Qué hacer si se filtró mi correo](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/que-hacer-si-se-filtro-mi-correo/):
  the seven steps in the order that matters, and the three things that do not help.
- [Cómo saber si mi contraseña fue filtrada](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/como-saber-si-mi-contrasena-fue-filtrada/):
  k-anonymity explained without jargon, and what the leak count actually means.
- [Política de privacidad](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/privacidad/)
- [Términos y condiciones](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/terminos/)

## Written pages (English)

- [FAQ](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/en/faq/)
- [What to do if your email was leaked](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/en/what-to-do-if-your-email-was-leaked/)
- [How to know if your password was leaked](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/en/how-to-know-if-your-password-was-leaked/)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/en/privacy/)
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.am-i-exposed.com/en/terms/)

## Who runs it

- Operator: Selentic Group S.A.C., a cybersecurity company based in Lima, Peru.
  https://www.selenticgroup.com/
- Contact: info@selenticgroup.com
- Breach data: Have I Been Pwned (https://haveibeenpwned.com), used under its
  Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence.
- Price: checking an email address or a password is free. The personalised
  action plan report costs S/ 19.00 PEN and includes 30 days of access.
- Not to be confused with ami.exposed, am-i.exposed or "How Exposed Am I",
  which are different tools run by other people.

## What makes it different

Most breach checkers answer one question: were you in a breach, yes or no. This
one is built around the next question, which is what to actually do about it,
written for someone who is not a security professional and who reads Spanish.
